question: In Chapter 9, we saw the battle between the Witch of Envy and Reinhard, which had previously been said not to reach a conclusion. Even Reinhard was in such a battered state—would he eventually have been defeated and lost?
answer:
I realized something about the ridiculously broken performance of Reinhard's Divine Protection of the Phoenix, but when the Divine Protection of the Phoenix revives him, he comes back with his HP and MP completely full.

So if he's about to get beaten, he can just “whoosh” himself and come back, meaning he can't lose!
